summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd, a Tokyo-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its October 6, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting; 17,964,337 votes, about 46.9% of shares outstanding as of the July 6, 2026 record date, were present. Shareholders approved amending the articles to adopt a nominating-committee structure, elected eight directors including new independent director Dr. Edward Joseph Mills, elected Seiryu Audit Corporation as accounting auditor, and authorized issuance of up to 7,650,000 ordinary shares to Alexander Capital L.P. plus 75,000 shares to consultant Ashish Kapoor. This is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation transaction terms.
